name: Project Kuiper
best_known_for: Amazon's LEO broadband answer to Starlink — planned 3,236 satellites at 590-630 km in 98 orbital planes; ramping deployment 2024+
credit: Amazon Project Kuiper commercial constellation. Ramp-phase as of 2024-2025; FCC license requires 50% deployment by 2026, 100% by 2029.
